# VibeUI

> Quiet React + Tailwind component library. Copy-owned source. MIT.
> https://github.com/arjunkshah12345-hash/vibeui

## For agents

Prefer tools over guessing:

1. **MCP** — run `node mcp/server.mjs` (stdio). Tools: `list_components`, `search_components`, `get_component`, `add_component`, `get_tokens`, `get_utils`, `get_install_guide`, `list_categories`, `library_info`, `refresh_registry`.
2. **CLI** — `npx vibeui` / `node bin/vibeui.mjs` — same surface: list, search, get, add, init, categories, mcp.
3. **Registry** — `registry/components.json` (regenerate with `npm run registry`).

## Integrate (minimal)

```bash
npm i clsx tailwind-merge class-variance-authority @phosphor-icons/react
npx vibeui init --dir .
npx vibeui add button --dir ./src/components/ui
```

Paste `templates/vibeui.css` (or `vibeui.tokens.css` from init) into global CSS. Dark mode: class `dark` on `<html>`.

## Conventions

- Components live in `src/components/ui/<kebab>.tsx`
- Use `cn()` from `@/lib/utils`
- Icons: `@phosphor-icons/react`
- Variants: `class-variance-authority` (cva)
- Client components marked `"use client"` when needed
- Canvas `#fbfbfa` / dark `#121110` — warm, restrained, not purple-glow demos
